title: Reduction quantifier prefix
statement: For a nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean symbols, natural numbers $d,c$, a deterministic Turing machine $V$ over Booleans, and natural numbers $CV,cV$, define the quantifier prefix at length $n$ to be three consecutive blocks of $w$ existential quantifiers followed by the level quantifier sequence with parameters $(w,w)$, where $w=vwid(wCoef(N,d),c+1,n)$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a nondeterministic Turing machine over Booleans
$V$ is a deterministic Turing machine over Booleans
caveat: The level quantifier sequence is not defined in the supplied statement, so its precise content cannot be expanded.
